description: Carry a sealed parcel out through Ironside Street and Meltwater Row to a drop on Voss Avenue. Don't shake it, don't open it, don't ask. 15₵.
name: Parcel Run

emotes: {who} shoulders the parcel through Ironside Street, very carefully not looking inside it.
{who} hefts the parcel and pretends not to notice it's ticking. It probably isn't.
{who} adjusts their grip on the parcel and keeps walking, eyes forward.
{who} keeps the parcel moving through Meltwater Row, doing their best to ignore the funny smell coming from it.
{who} switches the parcel to the other arm and picks up the pace.
{who} mutters at the parcel to please, please stop shifting on its own.
{who} sets the parcel down on Voss Avenue and steps back fast, like it might go off.
{who} places the parcel carefully and doesn't stick around to see what happens next.
{who} drops the parcel and walks away without looking back.
